classification: bounded component-level liveness argument, not universal software correctness
state: configuration request has been queued; main worker may exit without answering; snapshot worker awaits response; shutdown awaits worker termination
original: Once no responder remains, receive from the unclosed response channel cannot complete. The snapshot worker cannot exit and the shutdown future remains pending.
repaired: With shutdown channel closed and no response available, the shutdown case is the only ready case in the response-wait select. Under eventual goroutine scheduling and finite cleanup, the snapshot worker returns and releases the shutdown wait.
assumptions: the snapshot worker is eventually scheduled
